title: 1934 — Elmer Noddin and Clint Hayward, Birmingham Farm, Rockland Road
description: In 1934, Elmer Noddin and Clint Hayward were haying on the Birmingham farm on Rockland Road, where the Hartland Community School is now located. Farmers faced many challenges in the area, including floods, early frosts, illness, and accidents. Even the loss of a horse could cripple a family's livelihood. Bartering and neighbour cooperation made survival possible, from barn raisings to sharing a threshing machine or helping with the harvest.
